title: Q-SAYDO-rules-DISPOSE-1: says DISPOSE-1, does not do it
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** say-do check (SAY-DO-1) on the watchdog run
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:DISPOSE-1
**Status:** closed

The system states `DISPOSE-1` (rules) and its code does not do it: python3 -m foundation dispose --check: an open item is 8.2 hours old, past the 6 hour limit plus two: the fleet pass is not disposing (DISPOSE-1, SLA-8H-1)

Change the code to do what the statement says, or change the statement to what the code does; never weaken the probe.

size: S

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation saydo --probe rules:DISPOSE-1` exits 0.

**Disposition:** fixed (executor-failed, 2026-11-22T06:52:09Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** the executor failed 3 consecutive runs on this item; last reason: RuntimeError: checks failed after 3 attempts: the reply was not valid JSON with a files list: RuntimeError: every code agent rung failed: github-models-llama: RuntimeError: non-JSON response (HTTP 200, text/plain) from https://models.github. Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).

**Evidence:** 2026-11-25T01:33:59Z closing probe passed after the item was disposed: {"id": "DISPOSE-1", "ok": true, "missing": [], "failing": [], "external": [], "unmeasured": [], "checks": 1}
